s1.p: Red Tape Navigator is an independent assistant that helps you find out which licences your business needs and fills in forms for you to review. It is not a government service. It never submits anything to a government portal for you.

s2.p:
Your email address and password (the password is stored only in scrambled form).
The goal you describe and the answers you give in the interview, such as your name, address and business details.
Aadhaar, PAN and bank details only if a form needs them. These are encrypted when stored.
A log of actions on your account, kept for security and to show what happened.

s3.h: Why we use it, and your consent
s3.p:
To research the rules, ask for missing details and fill in forms (service).
To send follow-up reminders, only if you agree (reminders).
To share the form you reviewed with our signing partner, or to fetch documents you approve from DigiLocker, only if you agree (identity providers). You approve each step on the partner's own page.

s4.p:
Our hosting and database providers, and our email provider (password reset and reminders).
Our SMS provider, only if you choose SMS reminders: your mobile number and the reminder text.
Digio, only if you choose Aadhaar e-Sign or DigiLocker: the form you reviewed and your email address. You enter your Aadhaar OTP on Digio's page; we never see it.
An AI model provider, when switched on: only the goal sentence you write and public government web pages. Aadhaar, PAN, bank details and interview answers are never sent to it.

s5.p: Session data is deleted automatically after the retention period shown above. You can download or delete your data at any time from the Account page.

s6.p: You can access and download your data, correct your answers, withdraw consent, and ask us to erase your account and data. Use the Account page, or contact the grievance officer shown above.

s7.p:
We use no advertising or tracking cookies.
Your login is kept in your browser's session storage and is cleared when you close the tab.
One cookie remembers your chosen language.

s8.p: Data is encrypted in transit. Aadhaar, PAN and bank details are encrypted when stored. No system is perfectly secure, so please keep your password private.

s1.p: Red Tape Navigator gives AI-assisted guidance. It is not legal advice and it is not an official source. Rules, fees and timelines change, so always verify with the issuing authority.

s2.p: You review every form before you can download or sign it. We never submit anything for you. You submit on the official portal yourself and complete any OTP or captcha there.

s3.p: Give true and complete information. Keep your password private. Do not use the service for anything unlawful.

s4.p: Our rules are collected from official sources and each one is marked until a reviewer confirms it. Fees, timelines and documents may differ from what we show. We cannot guarantee that an authority will accept an application.

s5.p: Signing and DigiLocker are provided by our partner, Digio, under its own terms. Government portals have their own terms. Aadhaar signing is done on the partner's page, not on ours.

s6.p: We work to keep the service running but cannot promise it will always be available. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for fees, delays or rejections by an authority.

s7.p: You can delete your account and data at any time from the Account page.

s8.p: Indian law applies to these terms.
